functions.name: QUERY
functions.description: Runs read-only SQL in Cairn as you; the rows spill, headers first.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: The connection; leave out for the default.

functions.name: METRIC
functions.description: A governed metric from Cairn, broken down by dimensions and filtered.

parameters.name: dimensions
parameters.description: Dimensions, e.g. "region, country", or a range of names.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters, e.g. "region = EU; amount >= 10", or a range.

functions.name: ASK
functions.description: Asks Cairn a question of your data; the answer's rows spill, headers first.
